Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Construcții, Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com
 About The Role
 For over two decades, Bitdefender has been protecting millions of users worldwide. A large part of that reach comes through our partners, who ship Bitdefender security under their own brand.
The Rebranding Team, part of the Partner Apps Stream, turns our mobile applications into those partner-branded products: different identities, different feature sets, different markets — the same protection underneath.
The word “rebranding” undersells the engineering. Different partner configurations bring different challenges: understanding why a feature behaves differently, identifying the cause and finding a solution that works across the affected products. Much of this job is investigation — analyzing logs, reproducing edge cases and tracing issues across codebases and teams. If you enjoy figuring out why something happens and working with others to solve it, you’ll like it here.
 What You’ll Do
Build and adapt features in our Android and iOS applications to meet partner-specific branding, feature and compliance requirements
Investigate issues by reproducing behavior, analyzing logs, testing hypotheses and working with colleagues across codebases and teams
Implement fixes and improvements with attention to their impact on other partner configurations
Contribute to shared code, configuration and build tooling that allows us to deliver and maintain multiple partner-branded products
Participate in the delivery process, from clarifying requirements and implementation to code review, testing and app store submission
Work closely with developers, QA, product, design and backend colleagues, as well as the people who manage partner relationships
Help automate repetitive tasks and improve how we configure, validate, build and release applications
Explore technical alternatives and propose improvements — questions and ideas are welcome at every experience level
 The team
 Small, tight-knit and genuinely helpful — the kind of team where asking a question is normal and nobody lets you stay stuck. We work in a dynamic environment, with varied partner requirements and frequent releases. You’ll move between implementation, investigation and delivery, learning how different parts of our products fit together.
You’ll have ongoing support and guidance from more experienced colleagues. Asking questions, discussing findings and working through unfamiliar problems together are part of how we work. We expect knowledge and autonomy to develop progressively.
 What We’re Looking For
1+ years of experience developing mobile applications on Android or iOS
Working knowledge of Kotlin or Java for Android, or Swift for iOS
Understanding of mobile application fundamentals: lifecycle, networking, storage and permissions
A structured approach to problem-solving: gathering information, reproducing issues, checking assumptions and explaining what you’ve found
Familiarity with Git, pull requests and code reviews
Ability to read requirements, ask questions when something is unclear and follow through on agreed tasks
An active interest in mobile security — permission models, secure storage, certificate handling
Willingness to learn the other mobile platform and work across both over time
Clear communication, a collaborative approach and readiness to ask for help when needed
Conversational English, written and spoken
 Nice to have
Flutter or another cross-platform framework
Experience with both mobile platforms (Android and iOS)
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
Understanding of REST / JSON API integration
Hands-on experience with security-related implementation: certificate pinning, secure storage, obfuscation
Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines or app store submission
Experience using AI assistants for debugging, log analysis or test generation
Any exposure to white-label, multi-tenant or configuration-driven products
 You don’t need to check every box. A solid foundation in one mobile platform, curiosity and a willingness to learn are a good starting point.
 What We Offer
Hybrid work
Private medical insurance
Ongoing technical support and guidance from experienced colleagues
Hands-on work with new and emerging technologies
AI tooling available in your day-to-day work
Real impact on cybersecurity — the code you write protects millions of people
Broad exposure to product development, from configuration and implementation to investigation and release
Opportunities to learn, explore ideas and contribute improvements to our products and ways of working
